europe_now.title: Record wildfire in Belgium prompts EU assistance
europe_now.summary: A wildfire in Belgium has scorched 3,000 hectares, forcing the evacuation of villagers. The European Union has sent firefighting aircraft to support containment efforts.

sources.headline: 🔴 Belgium wildfire scorches 3,000 hectares as villagers evacuate, EU sends aircraft

europe_now.title: Spanish jet shoots down drone over Romanian airspace
europe_now.summary: A Spanish fighter jet intercepted and destroyed a drone that violated Romanian airspace. The incident underscores heightened airspace security in the region.

sources.headline: Spanish fighter jet downs drone breaching Romania's airspace

top_stories.title: Belgium battles record wildfire with EU support
top_stories.summary: A wildfire in Belgium has burned 3,000 hectares, leading to the evacuation of nearby villagers. The European Union has deployed aircraft to assist local firefighting operations.

sources.headline: 🔴 Belgium wildfire scorches 3,000 hectares as villagers evacuate, EU sends aircraft
EU sends aircraft and villagers evacuate as Belgium battles record wildfire

top_stories.title: Drone intercepted over Romanian airspace by Spanish jet
top_stories.summary: A Spanish fighter jet shot down a drone that had entered Romanian airspace without authorization. The encounter reflects ongoing vigilance over regional airspace security.

sources.headline: Spanish fighter jet downs drone breaching Romania's airspace

top_stories.title: Hungary raises Danube level to secure nuclear plant cooling
top_stories.summary: Hungary has sunk barges in the Danube River to increase water levels for the Paks nuclear power plant's cooling systems. The action addresses critically low river levels that risked plant operations.

sources.headline: Hungary uses sunken barges to raise Danube River to keep nuclear plant going

top_stories.title: Ukraine strikes Russian air base and rocket plant in Samara
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian forces conducted attacks on a Russian air base and a rocket manufacturing facility in the Samara region. The strikes target military infrastructure deep within Russian territory.
